title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description:
Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return the length of the longest sequence of **consecutive** values (each one greater than the previous by exactly 1) that can be formed from its elements.

The elements do not have to be adjacent in the array. Your algorithm must run in **O(n)** time.
hints: Put every number in a set.
Only start counting from a number whose predecessor (n - 1) is not in the set, then walk upward.
